scholarship_name: Bourse universitaire a l'etranger (Mastere et/ou Doctorat) - bourse specifique
funder: Ministere de l'Enseignement Superieur et de la Recherche Scientifique (MESRS), Direction Generale des Affaires Estudiantines - Direction des Bourses et des Prets
institutions_covered: Set annually by the ministerial circulaire; 2026-2027 circulaire n.61/25 carries separate annexes for Canada
duration_covered: Bourse de longue duree - full degree cycle, renewed annually
other_eligibility: Reserved to Tunisian nationals. Eligibility clause at https://best.rnu.tn/bourses-universitaires/ : 'Bourses universitaires a l'etranger (Mastere et/ou Doctorat) - Il s'agit de bourses qui sont destinees aux etudiants, parmi les laureats, qui souhaitent poursuivre leurs etudes de Mastere et/ou de Doctorat a l'etranger.' EUR 800/month = EUR 600 bourse + EUR 200 pret repayable over the 10 years following graduation. MESRS also pays frais d'inscription et de scolarite, couverture sociale, assurance maladie obligatoire, permis d'etudes and titre de transport. Candidate must first be nominated by his Tunisian home institution, which submits a nominal list of top-ranked students in the specialisations named in the annual circulaire; university then runs psychological tests and a written+oral language test; ranked files go to DGAE, then an oral panel per specialisation, then the Commission Nationale des Bourses a l'Etranger (manuel de procedures, MESRS, July 2020). Universite de Tunis El Manar states the additional conditions: degree obtained one or two years earlier, degree in a specialite named in the call, no more than one repeated year, arithmetic average of at least 12/20. Signed 'Engagement de retour au territoire de la republique' and a 'caution solidaire' by a guarantor are required. Whether students of private Tunisian institutions (e.g. Esprit) may be nominated is NOT confirmed - the procedure is written around public institutions and the bourse d'alternance variant is expressly limited to 'etablissements universitaires publics'.

scholarship_name: Bourse d'alternance (bourse de courte duree)
funder: Ministere de l'Enseignement Superieur et de la Recherche Scientifique (MESRS), Direction Generale des Affaires Estudiantines
institutions_covered: Any foreign host laboratory or institution accepted by the Tunisian doctoral school / university
duration_covered: Maximum 6 months per academic year
other_eligibility: Does NOT fund a European master's degree. Eligibility clause at https://best.rnu.tn/bourses-universitaires/ : 'des bourses de courte duree (maximum 6 mois par annee universitaires) destines aux etudiants tunisiens, parmi les laureats, et qui sont inscrits dans des etablissements universitaires publics, en deuxieme annee de Mastere de recherche ou en Doctorat, ou encore les etudiants de l'annee terminale du cycle d'ingenieur.' Applicant must therefore already be enrolled in a Tunisian PUBLIC institution - private-institution students are excluded by this clause. EUR 1000/month in the EU. Quota allocated to each university by the Direction des Bourses et des Prets and distributed via the doctoral schools (manuel de procedures, MESRS, July 2020).

scholarship_name: Pret universitaire a l'etranger
funder: Ministere de l'Enseignement Superieur et de la Recherche Scientifique (MESRS), Direction des Bourses et des Prets
countries_covered: Any country of study approved by MESRS
institutions_covered: NOT_FOUND
duration_covered: NOT_FOUND
other_eligibility: Loan, not a grant. Eligibility clause at https://best.rnu.tn/prets-universitaires/ : parents' annual net income must not exceed a ceiling fixed by ministerial arrete; selection also weighs academic results and alignment with the ministry's priority specialisations and destinations. Amounts differ by country and are fixed by arrete ('Les montants des prets, qui different d'un pays a l'autre, sont fixes par l'arrete du ministre'). A guarantor must sign a 'cautionnement solidaire'. Repayment over a maximum of 10 years, starting two years after the final instalment. Annual call issued by the Direction des Bourses et des Prets; best.rnu.tn carries a recurring 'Appel a candidature aux etudiants tunisiens non boursiers poursuivant leurs etudes a l'etranger pour les prets universitaires', so students already abroad and non-scholarship holders may apply.

scholarship_name: Government Scholarships Programme Tunesia
funder: Ministere de l'Enseignement Superieur et de la Recherche Scientifique (Tunisia); listed and administered through DAAD
institutions_covered: State and state-recognised universities in Germany
duration_covered: Up to 6 years, through to the master's degree
other_eligibility: Eligibility clause on the DAAD scholarship database entry (Objective / Who can apply): 'The programme supports students from the Republic of Tunisia' and 'The programme is aimed at applicants with a secondary education diploma wishing to take a Bachelor or Master's degree in Germany.' Entry point is therefore the secondary-school diploma, not the licence - a 180-ECTS holder entering directly at master's level is not the stated target group and the portal's selectable applicant status is 'Undergraduates'. Value: 'Tunesia's Ministere de l'Enseignement Superieur covers ... monthly scholarship payments, one-off payment of travel expenses, payments towards health insurance cover, payment of semester fees at German universities.' Selection: 'The Ministere de l'Enseignement Superieur et Recherche Scientifique Tunis is responsible for awarding the scholarships. The most important selection criteria are the candidate's academic achievements.' DAAD Regional Office Tunis, info@daad.tn.

scholarship_name: Stipendium Hungaricum
funder: Tempus Public Foundation / Government of Hungary, under a bilateral education agreement with Tunisia
institutions_covered: Hungarian higher education institutions listed in the Stipendium Hungaricum Study Finder
duration_covered: Full degree master's programme
other_eligibility: Tunisia is a named Sending Partner. Eligibility clause on https://stipendiumhungaricum.hu/partners/ under the Tunisia entry: 'Full degree master studies: Agricultural Sciences, Arts and Humanities, Social Science, Computer Science and Information Technology, Legal Science, Economic Science, Engineering Science, Medical and Health Science, Sport Science, Natural Science, Arts, Art Education, Political Science and Public Governance' - Track A is covered by Economic Science and Computer Science and Information Technology, Track B by Arts / Art Education / Arts and Humanities. Same entry: 'Name of responsible authority: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research. Name of responsible person(s): Imed BEN ABDERRAHIM. E-mail address(es): mesrs.dgci.bourses@gmail.com. Website: http://www.mes.tn. Telephone: +216 71 841 380 Ext. 3517. Address: Av Ouled Haffouz 1030 Tunis - Tunisia. Application deadline to Sending Partner is the same as the application deadline to Tempus Public Foundation.' Two-step: online application in DreamApply (maximum 2 programme choices) AND a parallel application to the Tunisian Sending Partner, which produces the nomination list in February. Applicants must score at least 56/100 in the Hungarian institution's entrance procedure. 2026/27 timeline: deadline 15 January 2026 14:00 CET, nomination lists February 2026, entrance exams March-May 2026, results June 2026.
deadline_relative_to: the scholarship application IS the university application (DreamApply) - the parallel MESRS nomination file is due on the same date
application_route: apply direct (DreamApply) and via home ministry (MESRS nomination)

scholarship_name: Borse di studio offerte dal Governo italiano a studenti stranieri e italiani residenti all'estero (IRE)
funder: Ministero degli Affari Esteri e della Cooperazione Internazionale (MAECI), Italy
institutions_covered: Italian state and legally recognised universities and AFAM institutions
duration_covered: Master's (Laurea Magistrale) and AFAM courses; renewable within the call's limits
other_eligibility: The call is published to Tunisians by the Italian Embassy in Tunis (ambtunisi.esteri.it, March 2026 announcement of the 2026-2027 bando) and was circulated in Tunisia in the 2025-2026 cycle as 495 monthly scholarships with an age limit of 18-28 for Laurea Magistrale and 30 for doctorate, requiring an Italian language certificate at B2 except for English-taught courses (La Presse de Tunisie, 8 May 2025, reporting the MESRS-circulated offer). The official annex 'List of eligible countries and other territories' on https://studyinitaly.esteri.it/ListaBandi could not be opened, so Tunisia's presence on the country list is inferred from the Tunis embassy publication rather than read from the annex. Scholarships are valid only for courses held on Italian territory ('Scholarships are available for attending academic courses on the Italian territory only').

scholarship_name: Bourses de formations internationales 2027-2028
funder: Academie de Recherche et d'Enseignement Superieur (ARES), Federation Wallonie-Bruxelles, Belgium
institutions_covered: Fixed ARES catalogue - for 2027-2028: 1 bachelier de specialisation, 8 masters de specialisation and 1 continuing-education certificate
duration_covered: Duration of the specialisation master's programme
other_eligibility: Tunisia is one of the 32 ARES partner countries listed on the call page. Blocking eligibility clauses on the same page: the applicant must be a permanent resident of and working in one of the 32 eligible countries; must hold a higher-education diploma meeting the programme's admission requirements, obtained no more than 20 years before the training starts (extended by one year per child); and must demonstrate at least two years of relevant professional occupation after graduation. Only one programme may be applied for. A 2027 graduate with no professional experience does not meet the two-year work-experience condition. The 2027-2028 catalogue of masters de specialisation was not checked programme by programme against Track A / Track B. The grant covers international travel, a subsistence allowance, visa fees, registration costs and insurance; no monetary amount is stated on the call page.

scholarship_name: Programme de bourses en grandes ecoles francaises 2026
funder: Institut francais de Tunisie / Ambassade de France en Tunisie
institutions_covered: French grandes ecoles d'ingenieurs ou de commerce entered through the national concours
duration_covered: 36 months
other_eligibility: Reserved to Tunisian nationals only - dual Franco-Tunisian nationals are excluded. Eligibility clause on the Institut francais de Tunisie call page: the candidate must be enrolled in a second-year classe preparatoire in Tunisia or in a French preparatory institution during 2025-2026, pass the entrance examinations for the French grandes ecoles in 2025-2026, and be admitted to a French engineering or business school for 2026-2027. A holder of a three-year licence cannot enter through this route. EUR 877.50 per month covering accommodation and meals, plus student health and mutual insurance; registration and tuition fees are NOT covered. Selection by a 'commission paritaire franco-tunisienne'. Dossiers must reach the Institut francais de Tunisie by 14 August 2026 at 14:00; results from 28 August 2026.

scholarship_name: Programme de bourses partenariales - niveau Master 2 recherche
funder: Institut francais de Tunisie / Ambassade de France en Tunisie, with MESRS
institutions_covered: French universities hosting the second year of a Master recherche under an inter-university double-diploma agreement
duration_covered: September to June of the following year (one academic year)
other_eligibility: Open only to Tunisian nationals but with a blocking entry condition. Eligibility clause on the MESRS relay page for the 2021 call (https://best.rnu.tn/offre-de-bourses-partenariales-niveau-master-2-recherche-2021/): 'Etudiants tunisiens inscrits en deuxieme annee de formation d'ingenieur ou en premiere annee Master recherche' in Tunisia who intend to take the second year of the Master recherche at a French university under a double diploma; the candidate must hold the inter-university agreement and its specific avenant, and must have validated the first semester of Master 1. All disciplinary fields are eligible. A holder of a licence who has not started a Tunisian master cannot apply. LIVENESS NOT CONFIRMED: the last call visible on the MESRS scholarship portal timeline is 'Programme de bourses Ingenieur/Master 2 (IFT)' dated 31 May 2024; the 2025 and 2026 entries on the same timeline cover only the Ingenieur-Ingenieur programme, and the Institut francais de Tunisie page for this programme now returns 404.

scholarship_name: Programme de bourses d'etudes Ingenieur-Ingenieur du Gouvernement francais
funder: Gouvernement francais / Institut francais de Tunisie, with MESRS
institutions_covered: French ecoles d'ingenieurs delivering a double ingenieur/ingenieur diploma with a Tunisian engineering school
duration_covered: 22 months from September
other_eligibility: Eligibility clause in the Campus France Tunisie programme brochure: 'Programme reserve aux eleves ingenieurs de niveau bac+4 inscrits dans une ecole d'ingenieurs en Tunisie et preparant un double diplome ingenieur / ingenieur avec une ecole d'ingenieurs francaise.' A holder of a three-year licence from a business school is outside this target group. The call is live for 2026: MESRS relayed 'Appel a candidatures - Bourses d'etudes Ingenieur-Ingenieur du Gouvernement francais' on 4 June 2026, directing candidates to the Institut francais de Tunisie. Amount and covered items were not published on either relay page and the Institut francais de Tunisie call page returned 404 at the time of checking.

scholarship_name: Bourse d'excellence Eiffel (France Excellence Eiffel)
funder: Ministere de l'Europe et des Affaires etrangeres (France), managed by Campus France
institutions_covered: French higher education institutions - the institution, not the student, submits the application
duration_covered: Master M2 maximum 12 months; Master M1 maximum 24 months; engineering diplomas maximum 36 months
other_eligibility: Open to non-French nationals; Campus France Tunisie names Eiffel as one of the two programmes financed directly by the French foreign ministry for foreign students ('25% de ces bourses sont financees directement par le ministere dans le cadre des programmes Eiffel (pour des etudes au niveau master ou doctorat) ou Major'). EUR 1,200 per month at master's level from January 2026, plus international and national transport, insurance, help finding housing and cultural activities; tuition fees are NOT covered. Application route is the blocking constraint: 'French institutions submit applications exclusively' - the student must first secure the support of the international relations office of a French institution, which then files the candidacy on the Campus France platform. Deadline for the current cycle was not stated on the Campus France page (updated 30 September 2025).
deadline_relative_to: before university application (the institution must agree to nominate before or alongside admission)

scholarship_name: Programme de bourses IsDB-France
funder: Islamic Development Bank (IsDB), French Ministere de l'Europe et des Affaires etrangeres and Campus France
institutions_covered: French higher education institutions
duration_covered: One complete study cycle (Licence 3 or Master)
other_eligibility: Tunisia is named among the 42 eligible countries on the Campus France programme page, at Licence 3 and Master level, with government-scholar status (visa fees waived, tuition exemption, housing assistance, medical cover), EUR 700 per month and an economy return flight; 200 scholarships per year, of which the Campus France Tunisie brochure states 12 were allocated to Tunisia. LIVENESS NOT CONFIRMED: the only Campus France page still carrying the programme describes the 2020/2021 intake with an application window of 20-30 June 2020; the equivalent page on tunisie.campusfrance.org now returns 404; and the IsDB 2026-2027 scholarship programme list (https://www.isdb.org/scholarships/scholarship-programs) contains only four programmes, none of them IsDB-France. Do not rely on this scheme without direct confirmation from Campus France Tunisie or IsDB.

scholarship_name: Master of Science Scholarship Programme (M.Sc.) for IsDB Least Developed Member Countries
funder: Islamic Development Bank (IsDB)
institutions_covered: Universities in IsDB member countries ranked in the top 1,000 of the Times Higher Education ranking
duration_covered: Two years maximum
other_eligibility: Two independent exclusions. First, the eligibility list in the official M.Sc. booklet reads 'Citizen of any of the 20 Least Developed member countries' - Tunisia is an IsDB member country but is not one of the 20 LDMCs, so it is outside the target group. Second, the Institutions of Study section reads 'The successful candidate for the program must secure admission at one of the IsDB member countries' universities listed in the top 1000 in the Times Higher Education Supplement (THES) ranking' - European destinations are therefore excluded regardless of nationality. Fields are limited to science, engineering, technology and medicine, and the age limit is 30.

scholarship_name: Merit Scholarship Program for High Technology (MSP) for IsDB Member Countries
funder: Islamic Development Bank (IsDB)
institutions_covered: Universities in IsDB member countries in the top 1,000 of THE or QS; priority to countries with an IsDB cooperation agreement
duration_covered: 36 months PhD or 6-12 months post-doctoral research
other_eligibility: Not a master's scheme. The Fields of Study section of the official MSP booklet reads 'The program covers studies and research at two levels: (i) three-year or 36 months (about 3 years) Ph.D. study, and (ii) 6-12 months post-doctoral research.' Tunisia is an IsDB member country and would be nationality-eligible, but there is no master's track, and the Eligibility Requirements section further restricts it to 'scholars from MCs who are attached to educational, scientific, and technological institutions and research centers in their home countries', nominated institutionally rather than individually.

scholarship_name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme (ISP)
funder: Aga Khan Foundation
countries_covered: Afghanistan, Australia, Bangladesh, Egypt, India, Kenya, Kyrgyz Republic, Madagascar, Mozambique, New Zealand, Pakistan, Syria, Tajikistan, Tanzania, Uganda (plus Canada, Portugal and USA for applicants originating from those countries)
institutions_covered: Any accredited university, master's prioritised
duration_covered: Duration of the postgraduate programme
other_eligibility: Tunisia does not appear on the AKF ISP country list published on the programme page - awards are 'handled by contacts in countries where AKF ISP is available' and Tunisia is not among them. Structure noted for completeness: half grant and half loan, with 50 per cent of the award repayable; travel, clothing, furniture and family costs excluded. The 2026-2027 cycle is closed and the next cycle opens in early 2027.

scholarship_name: Mo Ibrahim Foundation scholarships (University of Birmingham MSc; Chatham House Academy Fellowship)
funder: Mo Ibrahim Foundation
institutions_covered: University of Birmingham; Chatham House
duration_covered: Two-year MSc; ten-month fellowship
other_eligibility: Nationality-eligible but geographically out of scope. The scholarships page states 'the scholarships listed below are the only ones we currently offer and are for African nationals only' - a Tunisian national qualifies as an African national, but both awards are held in the United Kingdom (MSc in Governance and State-Building at the University of Birmingham; Academy Fellowship at Chatham House), which the brief excludes. The Foundation offers no continental-European award.

scholarship_name: Said Foundation Scholarship Programme
funder: Said Foundation
institutions_covered: UK partner universities
duration_covered: One-year master's
other_eligibility: Doubly excluded. The programme targets 'outstanding individuals with leadership potential who will be drivers of positive change within our target countries of Syria, Jordan, Lebanon and Palestine' - Tunisia is not a target country. Separately, 'We offer scholarships for one-year master's degree courses in the UK' and applications for study outside the UK are not considered.

scholarship_name: Fondation Hassan II pour les Marocains Residant a l'Etranger - programmes de bourses
funder: Fondation Hassan II pour les Marocains Residant a l'Etranger (Morocco)
countries_covered: Morocco and countries of residence of the Moroccan diaspora
institutions_covered: NOT_FOUND
duration_covered: NOT_FOUND
other_eligibility: Verified as Morocco-only, as the remit asked. The foundation is a Moroccan public-interest institution created in 1990 whose statutory object is the Moroccan community resident abroad ('La Fondation Hassan II pour les MRE est une institution a but non lucratif ... Elle a pour objet' the Moroccan diaspora). Its programmes are addressed to Moroccan nationals and their children; there is no Tunisian eligibility route. Not to be confused with the separate Moroccan Fondation H2 'bourses de merite' (1,000 MAD/month), which is likewise Moroccan-only.

scholarship_name: OPEC Fund Scholarship Award
funder: OPEC Fund for International Development (formerly OFID)
countries_covered: Any country worldwide (recent awardees studied in the UK, Belgium and the Netherlands)
institutions_covered: Accredited universities worldwide
duration_covered: Master's degree, historically up to one year
other_eligibility: SUSPENDED. The official page states 'the OPEC Fund is currently restructuring its scholarship program and is not accepting applications at this time', so no current call, deadline or amount exists. The award historically supported 'outstanding young individuals from developing countries so that they are able to pursue graduate studies in a development-related field', with study permitted anywhere in the world, but no official country list naming Tunisia was found and the historical criterion excluding nationals of OPEC Fund member countries could not be confirmed on an official page. Fields were restricted to development-related disciplines.

scholarship_name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships - Art Scholarships
funder: State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI), Switzerland
institutions_covered: Swiss universities of the arts
duration_covered: Master's degree in an artistic field
other_eligibility: The only Swiss federal excellence scholarship that funds an initial master's is the Art Scholarship, and the SERI page states it is 'available to students from a limited number of countries only' without publishing the list at the time of checking. The Research Fellowship track is explicitly post-master's ('early career researchers ... who have already completed their Master's degree') and therefore does not qualify. SERI states 'Information on application deadlines and scholarship available by country of origin will be published here in August 2026' and 'Applications are open starting August 20, 2026', so Tunisia's inclusion for the 2027-28 cycle can only be confirmed after that publication. Applications are made through the Swiss embassy in the country of origin.
